basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and gadget lover based in Bristol, UK. By day, I work as a junior software developer, and by night, I'm often found tinkering with various tools and tech gear. I enjoy exploring minimalistic lifestyles, which reflects in my top subreddits. My interests include multitools, coding, and writing limericks. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, especially during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a BSc in Computer Science from a local university. Most of my knowledge is self-taught through online courses and forums. I have a keen interest in Swiss Army knives, particularly Victorinox products, and enjoy learning about their various models and uses.
